entries.title: 1 gone, 6 reclassified — 9 houses fit
entries.lede: Today's refresh found 1 gone, 6 reclassified. Top of the list is still 486 Robin Dr, Prescott at $3,150. Today's browser pass (Apartments.com, Zumper, HotPads, Trulia, Peak, Pierce and the ERAU board) found no new houses that fit; every house it already tracked is still shown at the same rent. It added details for houses already on the list (486 Robin Dr, 117 N Equestrian Way, 7906 E Carbon Ct and the undisclosed-address Hidden Valley Ranch 5-bedroom). Corrections: 1768 Rolling Hills Dr and 1924 Rocky Dells Dr are vacation rentals, 901 Hemlock Ave (3–6 month maximum) and 854 S Granite St are short-term furnished rentals, and 1640 Sherwood Dr lists only a game room (no den or office), so they are now excluded; 342 S Marina St moves to borderline because its "home office" wording refers to the four bedrooms themselves, not an extra room.

entries.title: First pull: 16 houses fit
entries.lede: First data pull for the Prescott house hunt. I checked 12 listing sources and found 16 whole-house rentals with 5+ bedrooms or 4 bedrooms plus a den/office/loft. The strongest fit right now is 1478 Varsity Dr, Prescott (5 BR, $2,900, about 11 min to campus). A separate browser pass of Apartments.com, Zumper, HotPads, Trulia (sites that block automated fetching) added 4 more matches and 6 borderline houses (4 bedrooms plus a family room or casita, listed separately, not counted).
